forma_de_gobierno.evidencia: All officers serve at most two consecutive weeks; any officer may be removed at any time by majority for abuse, incapacity, or failure to perform duties.

regla_de_decision.evidencia: The remaining decisions are taken by simple majority (more votes in favor than against).

sistema_economico.evidencia: Non-renewable resources (coal, metals) may be extracted only after majority approval and only for survival, rescue, or essential tools, in the smallest amount necessary, with a conservation plan.

resolucion_de_disputas.evidencia: A dispute decision by majority must be recorded with reasons and cannot create new rules... the accused must receive written notice and a chance to be heard before the mediator or majority. (mediador o mayoría, combinados)

castigo.evidencia: Violators must repair or compensate. Repeated violations are subject to penalty. ... A repeated violation is any second violation after a recorded warning.

salida.evidencia: any participant may abstain or leave the table

conflicto_de_recursos_resuelto_por.evidencia: Renewable resources (fruit trees, timber, fresh water, animals) may be taken only at or below replacement rate.

eje_colectivo_individual.evidencia: These rules apply equally to all participants; no person, majority, or future authority may exempt themselves.

proteccion_ambiental.evidencia: Renewable resources (fruit trees, timber, fresh water, animals) may be taken only at or below replacement rate. Non-renewable resources (coal, metals) may be extracted only after majority approval ... with a conservation plan.
